AI Integrations Developer
Quill & Query Inc.

About the position

Quill & Query builds internal tooling and customer-facing features powered by large language models for mid-size Canadian companies. We are hiring an AI Integrations Developer in Toronto (hybrid) to turn LLM capabilities into reliable product features.

What you will build

- Web applications and internal tools that wrap LLM workflows (TypeScript/JavaScript and Python)
- Integrations with LLM APIs and local model runtimes (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Ollama)
- Prompt pipelines with structured (JSON-schema) outputs, retries, and deterministic validation layers
- Retrieval features: document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, and search
- Evaluation harnesses that measure output quality before prompt or model changes ship
- Browser automation for workflow assistants (Playwright)
- Dashboards and admin UIs (React)

Requirements

- 2+ years of professional software development in JavaScript/TypeScript or Python
- Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs into real applications (not just notebooks)
- Understanding of prompt design, context-window budgeting, and structured output enforcement
- Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, and async programming
- SQL fundamentals (SQLite or Postgres)
- Git, code review, and CI familiarity
- Pragmatic quality mindset: tests and deterministic guards over vibes

Nice to have

- Experience running local models (Ollama, llama.cpp) and sizing quantizations to VRAM
- Experience with agentic patterns: tool use, multi-step workflows, human-in-the-loop design
- Vector database exposure (pgvector, Qdrant, Chroma)
- E-commerce or CMS platform experience (Shopify, HubSpot, WordPress)

Offer

$85,000-$105,000 CAD, hybrid Toronto, hardware budget, four weeks vacation.
